$PONS is using @Uniswap's V4 hooks to build custom trading and liquidity rules directly into its pools...

Uniswap V4 hooks let protocols add their own logic to liquidity pools instead of being limited to the standard pool setup

For Pons, this means:

• Reducing creator dump pressure through custom fee logic
• Going beyond V3's standard liquidity model
• In V4 hooks, Pons will have more control over liquidity and trading rules
